publishedfiledetails.title: Orchid Mod
publishedfiledetails.description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ArPhxjn.png[/img]

The [b]Orchid Mod[/b] aims to add content to the game in polished and refreshing ways. You will not find the usual vanilla class items here, as the content Orchid Mod provides is based on new classes with unique and complex mechanics.

[h1]Current Version : 1.5.3[/h1]
- Adds a bunch of new items, focused mainly on prehardmode Thorium Mod Cross-Content.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kcLoweG.png[/img]
The Orchid Mod currently adds one (and a half) new classes: the [b]Guardian[/b] and the [b]Shapeshifter[/b].

These new classes are aimed at experienced players, looking for a refreshing way of playing the game. They can be considerably harder to play than vanilla classes, and might require some dedication to achieve a desirable damage output.

[h1]Guardian[/h1]
The [b]Guardian[/b] is a living wall, using heavy [b]Pavises[/b], [b]Gauntlets[/b], [b]Quarterstaves[/b] and devastating [b]Warhammers[/b] to crush their foes and defend themselves.
Unique [b]Runes[/b] will provide the player with long lasting damage, and [b]Standards[/b] will provide usefull effects in battle.

Weapons are tied to unique [b]Slam[/b] and [b]Block[/b] resources that should be restored using a good weapon rotation.

[i]Alternating between defensive and offensive stances while staying in the middle of the fight is the key to playing the guardian class effectively.[/i]

[b]The Guardian class has content spread thourough the entire game, and allows comfortably beating it[/b]

[h1]Shapeshifter[/h1]
The [b]Shapeshifter[/b] vanquises their foes by transforming into multiple [b]wildshapes[/b], each having unique abilities and completely replacing normal movement.

[b]Predators[/b] are fast, and excel at single-target, while [b]Sages[/b] are slower, but can control and deal damage to multiple enemies.
[b]Wardens[/b] unleash slow but powerful hits while healing their wounds, and [b]Symbiotes[/b] turn into powerful teammates, requiring a [i]multiplayer friend[/i] to function!

[i]Adapting to the unique movement of each wildshape, and picking the right one for each battle is the key to playing the shapeshifter class![/i]

[b]The Shapeshifter class has content up to the Wall of Flesh[/b]

The mod does not have Calamity cross-content
It works with the mod, but the classes will be underpowered.[/quote]

We would rather work on stuff we enjoy, which in the end gets us to produce more content, of higher quality

publishedfiledetails.title: Aequus
publishedfiledetails.description:
Aequus had been deleted from the workshop in early 2025, so I decided to port it to the current version from the public Github, fixing the bugs that popped up whenever I could. I most likely don't have the programming ability to port to 1.4.5 such a complex mod that I didn't code, however I still wanted to post it to the workshop for the sake of posterity, giving people the ability to roll back tmod to 1.4.4 and have a way to play it that way, if it gets deleted I'll post it somewhere else, probably the terraria forums.

Aequus is one of the best mods around in terms of quality, however it adds next to nothing past early hardmode so be wary of content drying out past that stage of the game.

Known issues: (feel free to report the others you come across)
-I couldn't get the Dryad to sell the modded Planter Boxes because they are coded so oddly (one single class instances all 4 of them), so I made them craftable with wooden platforms instead
-The Exporter's reroll function is completely broken, I don't even know what it was supposed to do in the first place, if anyone remembers tell me and I can try to fix it

publishedfiledetails.title: Lunar Veil Legacy
publishedfiledetails.description:
[h1]Welcome to Lunar Veil![/h1]
 
 This is still an ongoing project with our upcoming 2.0 update! With massive amounts of content etc.

 I sincerely thank you for checking out this mod!, this mod as legacy is finalized so feel free to play with your friends, etc.
 This is a large content mod finished to the end on it's legacy build, see FAQ below for questions :)




 [h2]FAQ[/h2]

[b]Is this mod dead?[/b]
 Nope! Me and scolon are hard at work with 2.0! It'll be coming soon don't worry, and I'm sure you'll be pleasantly surprised with the scale of the update!
 Afterall we did finish all of legacy within 8 months or so, and 2.0 has taken us 2 years by itself to do and we are in the endgame now, so hold tight!


[b]Can I see 2.0?[/b]
 We have plenty of spoilers in the discord server, and if you ask me (Zenovia), you can also see stuff behind the scenes as well! I'm very open to
 showing people stuff even about 2.0, so come join the hype train! If you want to stalk us, we have a public github as well for devs and whatnot,
 it is to hold us accountable for the things we do to ensure trust.


 [b]Where's the discord server?[/b]
 At the bottom of the page.


[b]Release date?[/b]
Whoooo knows, maybe late this year (2026) or early next year, not too sure yet!


[b]Why this update?[/b]
We just wanted to finalize legacy before we take it and turn it into it's own mod when it releases, keeping the mod up to date as well.


[b]What will happen to legacy??[/b]
Nothing particularly, we are going to upload it as a seperate mod when 2.0 releases, as the changes are so vast, we kind of have to. 
Also it's nice for people to be able to compare the old mod and the new one! And also for keeping old things alive I guess...




[b]What mods should I play with this?[/b]
Any really! But I can't ensure completely compatibility due to how many structures are in the mod, but heres a few that work really well:
Thorium
Split
Magic Storage
Boss Checklist (we have compatibility)
Stars above
Calamity
Starlight river





[b]Changelogs?[/b]
Down below are just a bunch of grouped up big changes we did during each update, for a super detailed one, we have it in the server or github.










[h1]Pre~ 2.0 Stuff[/h1]


PLEASE PLAY MASTERMODE or EXPERTMODE FOR THIS MOD!
MULTIPLAYER COMPATIBLE!!!
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~


--------------------------------------------------------
The Eternal Moon Update: 1.3 has been released finishng prehardmode and all of its glory!
Go out and fight the new bosses accompanied with a higher being Verlia, the one of the Moon.
--
1.3.1 - Added a few new weapons
1.3.2 - Rebalancing of items
1.3.3 - Enemy spawn reduction and loot changes
1.3.4 - Boss Checklist compatibility
----------------------------------
Stars and Bloom update: 1.4 has been released, adding a bunch of QOL content, fixes and many more exploration!
The Royal Capital, Catacombs, Veriplant biomes. Fenix, Sylia, Stone Golem and many minibosses were added. 90+ new weapons, over 40 new accessories and fixes!
This update focuses on improving curent mechanics and adding an overall better vibe as well as a bunch of hardmode content as well as making the mod much more enjoyable!
----
1.4.1 - Some Generation fixes
1.4.2 - Texture configuration added, multiplayer stuff
1.4.2.1 - Fixed Dreadmire's phases breaking
1.4.2.2 - Fixed a lot of bugs and some item issues!
-----
Prismatic love Update: 1.5 has been released!
See the new improvements across the mod containing 2 new bosses, MULTIPLAYER COMPATIBILITY and a bunch of new edits to make this mod feel super special! World generation differences and 
small little parts, quests and remakes to make everything up to standard! Much balancing and new ways to pay, including many weapons and accessories to fill out other classes!
(Melee doesn't get much so go suck it). Cinderspark, Royal Capital overhaul, Veriplant overhaul, Xixian village and many underground structures were added! Harvesting now feels good as well!
----
1.5.1 - Some multiplayer fixes
1.5.2.5 - A lot of bug fixes and config option fixes 
-----
Green Sun Update: 1.6 Has been released!
Introducing many new systems like weapon swapping, Dialogue, Pages, reworked undergrounds and environments and quests! 4 New Post plant - Post ML bosses! Gothivia, Rek, Supernova fragment and Niivi!
Many reworks to older bosses such as Verlia, Sylia, Dreadmire and Irradia! More npcs and many more structures as well as structure fixing from old bugs. Over 100+ new weapons with new weapon types such as 
Steins, Greatswords, Orbs, Gun Holstering and more! Overhauls to many of the old weapons (60+) and recipes while gearing the game more towards our new systems! New biomes such as the Illuria, Veil Towers, 
Worshipping spots! Green Sun is the main event during this update and it's a long lasting event that covers through Irradia to Gothivia (Our new God tier boss!). More connected lore and overall even more
polish.
--------------
1.6.1 - Many boss buffs and nerfs, new weapons, 70+ More switchable weapons and balancing to accessories!
1.6.2 - Gave credit to some code for where it was due. Bug fixes and it's official name of Legacy added.
-----------------
Remirror Update: 1.7 has been released!
As some issues arose in 1.6 due to complications of a member stealing a bunch of assets on merge, we split off and decided to resprite/redo many systems to keep the mod in tact.
Stone golem has also gotten a much needed rework as well as a few new items and rebalancing! New visuals to many projectiles and bosses!
If there are issues please let us know :)
-----------------
The Undying Wait Update: 1.8 has been released!
As 2.0 has been in development, we wanted to fix some of the major issues of the mod to make it more playable, which means fixing up multiplayer, generation, weapons, progress, recipes, 
bloat, etc! We also added a few things we forgot to add/ lost content, and we added them and made sure they worked!

[url=https://www.bisecthosting.com/starsabove] Bisect Hosting [/url] ➔ Game Servers ➔ Terraria
[img]https://i.imgur.com/giHAnWT.jpg[/img]

The Stars Above is a Terraria expansion mod that adds a wide variety of content and a new important game mechanic:
the Starfarer system. The Stars Above guarantees a unique experience for any playthrough with new bosses, new areas to explore, and a focus on buildcrafting and player diversity.


A brief overview of the mod's features:
[list]
    [*]Full Multiplayer support
    [*]Two fully furnished deuteroganists with over 1000+ lines of dialogue and custom UI
    [*]Modular, upgradable ultimate abilities that scale with boss progression
    [*]Upgrade weapons with tons of interesting and varied collectible items for even more build diversity
    [*]Ability to explore unique premade locations throughout the galaxy with help from Subworld Library
    [*]24 custom unlockable passive abilities present in a unique weight-based system
    [*]80+ special unique weapons that have malleable damage types, alternate abilities, charged attacks, etc.
    [*]Unique pre-rendered cutscenes for certain events and abilities
    [*]9 unique bosses each with their own special cast-centric AI
    [*]Plenty of pets, accessories, and utility items
    [*]Settings to tailor the mod's content to your liking
    [*]Compatibility with 100% of major content mods (sometimes with unique dialogue)
    [*]And much more!
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/X17qv7R.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QOTBoxQ.png[/img]

[h1]STARFARERS[/h1]

The Stars Above's flagship feature: Meet Asphodene and Eridani, masters of Astral and Umbral respectively.
Empowered by their strength and led by their guidance, you will be able to challenge any foe Terraria has to offer. These charismatic deuteragonists boast tons of unique dialogue for bosses, biomes, and more. (However, if you don't care for it, most dialogue can be disabled in the Mod Settings!)
As of v2.1, enjoy over 100+ voice lines by Kiera Rhodes, giving life to the Starfarer's conversations!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/X17qv7R.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/u9x6xLX.png[/img]

[h1]WEAPONS[/h1]

Obtain extraordinary weapons with layers of strategy and myriad powers to overwhelm your foes. Weapons are incredibly unique and can be adjusted to any damage class- including features such as charged attacks, timed counters, energy gauges, and more. Brandish beloved weapons from your favorite game franchises re-imagined into the world of Terraria.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/X17qv7R.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aWJjPQE.png[/img]

[h1]STELLAR ARRAY[/h1]

Master the Stellar Array, a powerful supplement to player growth.
With 24 powerful passive abilities separated into 3 distinct tiers, you can mix and match to become the strongest Terrarian- buildcraft and skill expression tailored to any playthrough.
Your Starfarer has influence on what abilities you have available!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/X17qv7R.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gIs4E0h.png[/img]

[h1]BOSSES[/h1]

Defeat nine powerful unique bosses boasting a custom AI system:
Casted Attacks. Adapt and learn to defeat these formidable enemies!

Face off against the Vagrant of Space and Time, Penthesilea, the Witch of Ink, the Warrior of Light, and much more!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BEnNDqm.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DxeJHeK.png[/img]

[h1]WEAPON MEMORIES[/h1]

A new system added in The Stars Above v2.0, Weapon Memories are unique items obtained throughout game progression that can be slotted into Aspected Weapons. Give weapons Summon Tag Damage, gain buffs when killing foes, cause lightning to strike from your attacks, gain active abilities to change the tide of battle, and much more!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BEnNDqm.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z8XXAsH.png[/img]

[h1]THE NEON VEIL[/h1]

Explore a brand new biome in the Underworld complete with new unique loot, armor, and foes. The shining towers of the Neon Veil provide an incredibly unique new environment to explore- and a way to upgrade your Stellar Novas with unique set bonuses for even more buildcraft potential.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/X17qv7R.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/r4JTPlO.png[/img]

[h1]COSMIC VOYAGES[/h1]

Explore the Moirae Galaxy through a brand-new system added in The Stars Above: Celestial Cartography. With the help of Subworld Library, obtain rare materials, powerful accessories, and more.

As of tModLoader 1.4.4, multiplayer Subworld transit is now possible!
Keep in mind that there may still be issues with the system; if you do encounter said issues, you can enable Multiplayer Compatbility Mode in the Serverside Settings to revert to the old system.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/X17qv7R.png[/img]

[h1]ADDITIONAL CONTENT / MOD CROSSOVER CONTENT[/h1]

The features of The Stars Above doesn't stop here; express yourself with unique pets or empower yourself with the mod's unique accessories.

Turn Aspected weapons to Rogue Damage from Calamity, or Symphonic/Radiant/Throwing Damage from Thorium!

Your Starfarers will have unique dialogue for content from the following mods:
Calamity, Secrets of the Shadows, Verdant, Fargo's Souls, the Spirit Mod, Starlight River, Calamity: Wrath of the Gods, and the Thorium Mod. More will come soon!
Additionally, some separate scaling is present for the Calamity Mod. (This can be disabled in the Mod Settings.)

publishedfiledetails.title: Summoners' Association
publishedfiledetails.description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/W2c5CX6.gif[/img]

This mod aims to fix a few grievances with summons and flesh out Summoner to be a fully developed class. This vision is of a summoner who has their hands full buffing and controlling minions and has little time for other weapons.

[h1]Includes 5 items[/h1]
[b]Summoners' Association Card[/b] - Displays summoner-related information
[list]
[*] Shows the amount of minions summoned (out of the total available) under every minion buff
[*] Simply has to be in your inventory for it to work
[/list]
[b]Minion Control Rod[/b] - Dominate and direct your minions
[list]
[*] Left click to teleport all your minions to the cursor
[*] Right click to target an enemy, or spawn a reticle as a target
[/list]
[b]Minion Selection Book[/b] - Allows summoning any minion from the inventory
[list]
[*] Radial UI that shows all summon weapons in your inventory
[*] Keeps your hotbar clean
[/list]
[b]Minion Loadout Book[/b] - Allows summoning a set of minions from the inventory with one click
[list]
[*] Upgraded [b]Minion Selection Book[/b]
[*] Lets you define a "loadout" for a one click summon, instead of having to use every weapon individually
[/list]
[b]Automatic Minion Loadout Book[/b] - Summons a minion set automatically after respawn
[list]
[*] Upgraded [b]Minion Loadout Book[/b]
[*] Spawns the minions automatically when you (re)spawn
[/list]

[h1]Video Showcase[/h1]
Using the [b]Minion Loadout Book[/b] to set and summon a minion loadout:
[video mp4=https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/27f1f178-cec3-41ab-972a-56731f8ff728][/video]
Teleporting minions with the [b]Minion Control Rod[/b]:
[video mp4=https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/534f2b7c-11be-4634-9098-636023b13e11][/video]
Targeting a location with the [b]Minion Control Rod[/b]:
[video mp4=https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e437c845-bb32-41fe-9ca3-cb103171bebd][/video]

[h1]Other additions[/h1]
[b]Minion&Sentry Slots Info[/b] - Displays the amount of minions/sentries currently summoned out of the available slots on the right side of your screen, like similar informational accessories
[b]Minion&Sentry Slots Icon[/b] - Displays the amount of minions/sentries currently summoned above your defense
[b]Persistent Buffs[/b] - Summoning Potion, Bewitching Table, and War Table buffs will persist on death or world exit, allowing for a smoother experience
[hr][/hr]
Contains two configs: 'Server Config' contains settings related to the reticle from Minion Control Rod, Loadout Book, and vanilla tweaks, while 'Client Config' contains settings related to the UI and info icons

If you experience issues with Minion Control Rods' reticle feature, let us know on the homepage; You can continue using this mod by disabling the feature in the 'Server Config'

[b]Changelog:[/b]
v0.5.4
* Added additional behaviors to Minion Loadout Book and its upgrade:
    * Can now select regardless of player's minion limit
    * Added an additional button next to each weapon that when clicked, fills any remaining minion slots with this weapon
* Added a small mod icon
* Removed blank space around the Summoner's Association Card sprite

v0.5.3
* Added "Toggle Persistent Buffs" server config setting, on by default
* Added "AddPersistentBuff" Mod Call

[h1]Links[/h1]
Source code hosted on [url=github.com/JavidPack/SummonersAssociation]GitHub[/url], collaboration welcome
For questions or suggestions, come to my Discord: [url=discord.gg/w8Hcwby][img]https://discordapp.com/api/guilds/276235094622994433/widget.png?style=shield[/img][/url]
Bug reports in the comments here will not be seen, come to Discord or Github to report issues.
If you'd like to support my mods, I have a Patreon [url=www.patreon.com/jopojelly][img]https://i.imgur.com/xII2DwJ.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198025715866/myworkshopfiles/?appid=1281930]Check out all my mods[/url][quote=tModLoader SummonersAssociation]
Developed By jopojelly, direwolf420[/quote]

publishedfiledetails.title: Vibrant Reverie (W1K's Mod Redux)
publishedfiledetails.description:
Vibrant Reverie! Formerly W1K's Mod Redux, the successor to W1K's Modpack, W1K's Content Pack Remix and W1K's Sizeable Variety Package, now with 100% less questionable and a slightly more original name. 1.3 brings the mod to Terraria 1.4.4 with some cool new content and a new prototype boss that is mostly unfinished but bear with me the new mount is cool.

Vibrant Reverie (or also known as W1K's Mod Redux in ancient times) is the oldest Terraria mod still alive today. It is a content pack, compilation of my questionable coding prowess, designed to blend as much as my effort can possibly afford with the game's original concept of balance. This means:
- It includes contents, a REASONABLE amount of contents, NPCs, 10+ custom bosses, around 140+ items, at least by the last time I bothered checking.
- All bosses and a good chunk of NPCs have their own unique AIs.
- Vibrant Essence is dropped from fae (with some Touhou inspired enemies) which can be used for a multitude of things.
- Plenty of support for DoT builds. Poison debuffs deal constant damage while Fire debuffs deal higher damage to enemies at low HP perfect for burst weapons.
- Chargeable weapons. I love chargeable weapons. Melee swords that don't need you to be hugging the boss all the time, and other types that pack a punch when charged out of sight.
- It's balanced, with a maniacal level of attention. Dare to prove otherwise and you get a refund.
- You can turn into a dragon! (for real this time)
- You can also turn into another cool thing go figure it out yourself.
- Works just fine with AT LEAST Thorium Mod because I tried.
- Supports Boss Checklist and W1K's Weapon Scaling.

Refer to the official forum thread for more details.[quote=tModLoader W1KModRedux]
Developed By W1K[/quote]

publishedfiledetails.description:
[h1]Everglow Demo[/h1]

[h3]What is a demo?[/h3]
Demo stands for demonstration.
It means this version of mod is for demonstration purpose, 
instead of being played as a content mod.
You can get early access to part of the contents, 
but cannot have a relatively complete playthrough.

[h3]What is Everglow?[/h3]
Everglow is a comprehensive content mod, dedicated to add rich and interesting content into Terraria, which focuses on exploration, like every Terrarian did when playing this game for the first time.
These contents will cover all aspects of the game: from the Terraria Continent to a wider world, weapons, equipments, bosses, biomes, subworlds, and game mechanics.
With a unique module system, players can selectively load some modules to customize the mod content to a certain extent, and find their favorite way to play.
The content of the two mods, Eternal Resolve and MythMod, will each be partially migrated as a module, and may be linked to other mods in the future.
However, many of these features are not yet included in the demo, but will be eventually.

[h3]Player Feedback[/h3]
Bug reports and discussions: you can join our Discord server https://discord.gg/cUfyhqaPFe

This demo does NOT support multiplayer

publishedfiledetails.title: W1K's Weapon Scaling
publishedfiledetails.description:
Weapon Scaling 1.3 beta for 1.4 with support for the new weapons but things may break and mod compatibility is currently unimplemented. More testing is necessary but all appears fully functional.


Have you ever reached late-game and wished there was something exactly like Waterbolt, but that actually dealt enough damage to be usable? Or maybe you really wanted to run a whole fire-themed character but all molten weapons become useless as soon as you get some funny red ore? Or maybe you just really want to make the god of all shortswords?
Fear no more! We got you covered!

W1K's Weapon Scaling works in a very simple way. Every vanilla weapon (more on mods later) has been given an appropriate tier based on when they are obtained in the game, this system, alongside farmable upgrade items, let you upgrade the weapon of your choice to higher tier, damage scaling as appropriate.
To keep it simple, this was done through a lot of math and a funny excel sheet calculating the average DPS increases for each progression tier. The result is a somewhat balanced system of scaling that should keep your weapon of choice comparable or slightly inferior to weapons of the same tier.

Now, there's obviously downsides to this. Namely, not all weapons are perfectly balanced on their own. While I have done some individual adjustments myself, I can't try all potential weapon and tier combinations on my own, so I will ask for your comprehension and feedback so that I can keep tweaking the numbers further.

You might've noticed I specified vanilla. There is no way for me to determine the right tiers for weapons coming from external mods, HOWEVER, a solution is already in place.
Mod authors can specify compatible weapons, tiers and adjust scaling of any weapon through the comfiness of their own mods! This is quick and simple, if not a bit tedious for big mods. An example mod is provided in the related thread on the community forums. I will provide a list of supported mods as well as I am made aware!

So that's all! Enjoy your sadly-still-pathetic celestial-tiered wooden hammer![quote=tModLoader WWeaponScaling]
Developed By W1K & Suweeka[/quote]
